verdict.rationale: mParticle's Data Privacy Controls doc explicitly covers GDPR consent and CCPA opt-out state, and shows forwarding rules like 'Do not forward if CCPA Data sale opt out is present,' demonstrating suppression propagation to destinations. However, the evidence pack does not document an explicit 'right to be forgotten'/deletion request workflow (e.g., a Data Subject Request API) that removes user data across connected destinations, only consent/opt-out based forwarding suppression. Missing for 10: explicit deletion/erasure request handling and confirmation of deletion propagation to all destinations, independent verification of DSR fulfillment.
